title: Planned change: A/R Collection Totals follow the Customer chip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customers X and Z both have past-due invoices.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Write down the Totals row's Open Balance.
  4. Pick customer X in the Customer chip.
  5. Read customer X's group Open Balance.
  6. Read the Totals row's Open Balance.
  7. Clear the Customer chip.
  8. Read the Totals row's Open Balance.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 6:

  • PRD v12, 2. Feature Overview, What changes for existing users, quoted: “The Totals row on A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices now follows the customer or vendor filter; today it ignores it, on production too.”
  • Step 6 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): The Totals row equals customer X's Open Balance (production kept the all-customer total).
  • Step 8 (unchanged from before the release): With no customer chosen the Totals row is back to the figure from step 3.
  • Related existing case: DATA-10 C715459 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715459); DATA-12 C715461 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715461). This case checks the same planned change from the before-the-release side.

Why this matters: A total must match the rows above it.

SOURCE: A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, 2. Feature Overview, What changes for existing users. V1 behaviour before the change: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountReceivable/Service/DbalCollectionsTotalFetcher.php:33-75; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApUnpaidInvoicesFetcher.php:122-138.

This is the expected behaviour as per the A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, 2. Feature Overview, What changes for existing users, for epic SV-11315; the V1 behaviour it changes is recorded in AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-110). Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
